title: Polynomial-time closure under many-one reductions
statement: Let $L$ and $L'$ be languages of binary strings. If $L$ is polynomial-time many-one reducible to $L'$ and $L'\in\mathsf{P}$, then $L\in\mathsf{P}$.
hypotheses_covered: $L,L'$ are languages over the binary alphabet
replaced:
Let $L, L' \subseteq \{0,1\}^{*}$ be languages such that $L$ is polynomial-time
Karp reducible to $L'$. If $L' \in \mathsf{P}$, then $L \in \mathsf{P}$
[AB09, remark after Definition~2.7].
